title: US Regular All Formulations Gas Price
attribution: U.S. Energy Information Administration, via Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, FRED®, https://fred.stlouisfed.org/
caveats: Weekly, dated by the Monday of the survey. FRED has no value for 1990-12-10 through 1991-01-14, so the first observation inside the display window is 1991-01-21.
Nominal dollars, not adjusted for inflation.

title: US Diesel Sales Price
attribution: U.S. Energy Information Administration, via Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, FRED®, https://fred.stlouisfed.org/
caveats: Weekly, dated by the Monday of the survey. The series begins 1994-03-28, so the diesel line starts later than the gasoline line.
All types of diesel (ultra-low sulfur and earlier grades). Nominal dollars, not adjusted for inflation.

title: 30-Year Fixed Rate Mortgage Average in the United States
attribution: Freddie Mac, Primary Mortgage Market Survey®. Copyright Freddie Mac, reprinted with permission per FRED; via Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, FRED®, https://fred.stlouisfed.org/
caveats: Third-party copyright (Freddie Mac). FRED requires contacting the owner for any use beyond personal; served here with attribution on the project owner's decision — see docs/INDICATORS_METHODOLOGY.md.
Freddie Mac changed the survey methodology on 2022-11-17 (now based on lender applications), a series break.
Weekly, dated by the Thursday of the survey.

title: All Employees, Total Nonfarm
attribution: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, via Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, FRED®, https://fred.stlouisfed.org/
caveats: A level (thousands of persons), not a flow. "Jobs added" is derived (month-over-month change) in lib/indicator-derive.ts.
Payrolls are heavily revised for months after first release; this holds the latest revised values at fetch time.

title: Unemployment Rate
attribution: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, via Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, FRED®, https://fred.stlouisfed.org/
caveats: No value for 2025-10-01 (the household survey was not collected that month); the gap is a single month.

title: Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers: All Items in U.S. City Average
attribution: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, via Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, FRED®, https://fred.stlouisfed.org/
caveats: An index (1982-84=100), not a rate. Inflation is derived (year-over-year percent change) in lib/indicator-derive.ts.
No value for 2025-10-01 (October 2025 prices were not collected); year-over-year inflation is undefined for 2025-10 and 2026-10.

title: Real Median Household Income in the United States
attribution: U.S. Census Bureau, via Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, FRED®, https://fred.stlouisfed.org/
caveats: Dated January 1 of the calendar year the income was earned; published the following September, so it lags the other series by most of a year.
Real dollars are re-based by the Census Bureau on each release, so every historical value shifts when the base year changes (FRED's units field says 2025 dollars, its notes say 2024).

title: Federal Surplus or Deficit [-] as Percent of Gross Domestic Product
source_agency: U.S. Office of Management and Budget; Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
attribution: U.S. Office of Management and Budget; calculated by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, via Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, FRED®, https://fred.stlouisfed.org/
caveats: Fiscal year (October-September), dated January 1 of the calendar year the fiscal year ENDS (FY2020 = 2020-01-01). Verified against the series' values (FY2020 = -14.5% of GDP).
Negative = deficit (FRED's sign, kept as-is).

title: Federal Debt Held by the Public as Percent of Gross Domestic Product
source_agency: U.S. Office of Management and Budget; Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
attribution: U.S. Office of Management and Budget; calculated by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, via Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, FRED®, https://fred.stlouisfed.org/
caveats: Headline debt measure: debt held by the public (the measure CBO uses), as % of GDP.
Dated at the first day of the quarter. Begins 1970-01-01 (not 1966).

title: Federal Debt: Total Public Debt as Percent of Gross Domestic Product
source_agency: U.S. Office of Management and Budget; Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
attribution: U.S. Office of Management and Budget; calculated by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, via Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, FRED®, https://fred.stlouisfed.org/
caveats: Total public debt, including debt the government owes itself (intragovernmental). Ingested alongside the held-by-the-public measure; which to display is deferred.
Dated at the first day of the quarter.

title: NBER based Recession Indicators for the United States from the Period following the Peak through the Trough
source_agency: National Bureau of Economic Research (via Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)
attribution: National Bureau of Economic Research business-cycle dates, as interpreted by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, via Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, FRED®, https://fred.stlouisfed.org/
caveats: Context only, for shading future charts: 1 = recession month, 0 = expansion. The month a turning point is assigned to is FRED's convention, not NBER's judgment.
